Layer.OnCommand: %function(self) self:zoom(0) if not Profile().IIDXGoldDecideSFX then AudioPlay('decide/default') elseif Profile().IIDXGoldDecideSFX == 'RANDOM' then local SFXList = {'default', 'extra', 'led', 'suzaku', 'taka', 'yoshitaka'} local RandomSFX = SFXList[math.random(#SFXList)] AudioPlay('decide/'..RandomSFX) else AudioPlay('decide/'..string.lower(Profile().IIDXGoldDecideSFX)) end end
